description: EOS6 OCM3 Sensor in Local Area Coverage (LAC) Mode provides Indian subcontinent coverage at 360m spatial resolution in 2 days in 13 visible to NIR wavelengths. All the data sets over 8 days are processed and total suspended matter (TSM) product is generated at 500m over the ocean. TSM represents the concentration of inorganic and organic particles suspended in water and is a key parameter for assessing water quality, understanding marine nutrient transport and monitoring ecosystem health.
title: EOS-06 OCM-LAC TSM 8day 500m

description: EOS6 OCM3 Sensor in Local Area Coverage (LAC) Mode provides Indian subcontinent coverage at 360m spatial resolution  in 2 days in 13 visible to NIR wavelengths. All the data sets over 8 days are processed and Vertical diffuse attenuation (DA) is generated at 500m over the oceans. This product quantifies the rate at which light decreases with depth in water and is particularly important for modelling phytoplankton health.
title: EOS-06 OCM-LAC DA 8day 500m

description: In EOS-04 Level-2B Normalized Radar Backscatter Analysis Ready Data (ARD)Product, terrain induced variations are normalized by the local illuminated area. The normalization of backscatter values provides true backscatter of the land cover irrespective of plain or hilly terrain. The geolocation accuracy of Level-2B is guaranteed to be within 30m, and hence considered suitable for temporal studies. EOS04–NRB data products for MRS and CRS ScanSAR imaging modes are in compliance with CEOS ARD NRB v1.0 Product Family Specifications.
title: EOS-04 SAR-CRS L2B

This product plays a vital role in modelling and forecasting potential fishing zones.

description: EOS6 OCM3 Sensor in Local Area Coverage (LAC) Mode provides Indian subcontinent coverage at 360m spatial resolution in 2 days in 13 visible to NIR wavelengths with a swath of ~ 1500 km over the Indian subcontinent. This 1500km X 1500 km Product quantifies the Aerosol Optical Depth/Thickness at 870nm which represents the amount of atmospheric aerosols (solid or liquid particles like dust, smoke, or pollution) that attenuate sunlight by scattering and absorption in a vertical column of the atmosphere. These products are useful in atmospheric correction of other geo-physical data products & study of climate effects of atmospheric aerosols.
title: EOS-06 OCM-LAC L2C-AOD
